mapper.select: SELECT d.dev_id AS id,jsonb_build_object('job',d.main_job_cd,'grade',d.grd_cd,'enabled',d.use_yn='Y', 'resign',d.rsgn_dt,'hire',d.hire_dt, 'jobs',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(j.job_cd ORDER BY j.job_cd) FROM mst.dev_sub_job j WHERE j.dev_id=d.dev_id),'[]'::jsonb), 'skills',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(k.skl_cd ORDER BY k.skl_cd) FROM mst.dev_skl k WHERE k.dev_id=d.dev_id),'[]'::jsonb), 'leaves',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('code',h.work_stts_cd,'start',h.bgn_dt,'end',h.end_dt) ORDER BY h.bgn_dt,h.work_stts_hist_id) FROM mst.dev_work_stts_hist h WHERE h.dev_id=d.dev_id),'[]'::jsonb), 'assignments',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',a.asgn_id,'projectId',a.prj_id,'projectName',p.prj_nm, 'customerId',p.cust_ptnr_id,'industry',p.indty_cd,'job',a.job_cd,'start',a.bgn_dt,'end',a.end_dt,'status',a.asgn_stts_cd, 'extension',a.ext_psblty_cd,'extended',EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM asgn.asgn_chg_hist h WHERE h.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND h.asgn_chg_ty_cd='EXTEND' AND h.fixed_yn='N'), 'early',EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM asgn.asgn_chg_hist h WHERE h.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND h.asgn_chg_ty_cd='EARLY_END' AND h.fixed_yn='N'), 'months',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('month',m.work_ym,'mm',m.mm_qty) ORDER BY m.work_ym) FROM asgn.asgn_mth m WHERE m.asgn_id=a.asgn_id),'[]'::jsonb)) ORDER BY a.bgn_dt,a.asgn_id) FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=a.prj_id WHERE a.dev_id=d.dev_id AND a.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED'),'[]'::jsonb), 'temporary',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',t.tmpr_asgn_id,'start',t.bgn_ym,'end',coalesce(t.end_ym,to_char(to_date(n.bgn_ym,'YYYY-MM')+(n.mnth_qty-1)*interval '1 month','YYYY-MM')),'mm',t.mm_qty) ORDER BY t.tmpr_asgn_id) FROM asgn.tmpr_asgn t JOIN bsn.oppt_need n ON n.need_id=t.need_id WHERE t.dev_id=d.dev_id AND t.tmpr_asgn_stts_cd='ACTIVE'),'[]'::jsonb))::text AS document FROM mst.dev d ORDER BY d.dev_id

SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('projectId',p.prj_id,'projectName',p.prj_nm,'startDate',a.bgn_dt, 'endDate',a.end_dt,'jobCode',a.job_cd, 'skillCodes',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(k.skl_cd ORDER BY k.skl_cd) FROM prj.prj_skl k WHERE k.prj_id=p.prj_id),'[]'::jsonb), 'monthByMonthMm',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('month',m.work_ym,'mm',m.mm_qty) ORDER BY m.work_ym) FROM asgn.asgn_mth m WHERE m.asgn_id=a.asgn_id),'[]'::jsonb)) ORDER BY a.bgn_dt,a.asgn_id),'[]'::jsonb)::text FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=a.prj_id WHERE a.dev_id=#{devId} AND a.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED'
SELECT dtl_cd FROM cmn.cd_dtl WHERE cd_grp_id='GRADE' AND use_yn='Y' ORDER BY sort_seq,dtl_cd
SELECT dtl_cd FROM cmn.cd_dtl WHERE cd_grp_id=#{group} AND use_yn='Y' ORDER BY sort_seq,dtl_cd
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mst.ptnr WHERE ptnr_id=#{id} AND use_yn='Y')
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cst.mth_cst WHERE dev_id=#{devId})
SELECT jsonb_build_object('cost',c.indv_lbr_cst_amt,'price',d.dflt_untprc_amt)::text FROM cst.mth_cst c JOIN mst.dev d ON d.dev_id=c.dev_id WHERE c.dev_id=#{devId} AND c.cst_ym=#{month}

SELECT md5(concat( (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(dev_id,main_job_cd,grd_cd,use_yn,rsgn_dt,hire_dt,updated_at) ORDER BY dev_id)::text FROM mst.dev), (SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) ORDER BY dev_id,job_cd)::text FROM mst.dev_sub_job t), (SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) ORDER BY dev_id,skl_cd)::text FROM mst.dev_skl t), (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(dev_id,work_stts_cd,bgn_dt,end_dt) ORDER BY work_stts_hist_id)::text FROM mst.dev_work_stts_hist), (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(asgn_id,dev_id,prj_id,job_cd,bgn_dt,end_dt,asgn_stts_cd,ext_psblty_cd,updated_at) ORDER BY asgn_id)::text FROM asgn.asgn), (SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) ORDER BY asgn_id,work_ym)::text FROM asgn.asgn_mth t), (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(tmpr_asgn_id,need_id,dev_id,bgn_ym,end_ym,mm_qty,tmpr_asgn_stts_cd) ORDER BY tmpr_asgn_id)::text FROM asgn.tmpr_asgn), (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(prj_id,prj_stts_cd,use_yn,cust_ptnr_id,indty_cd,updated_at) ORDER BY prj_id)::text FROM prj.prj), (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(psn_plan_id,prj_id,plan_ym,job_cd,grd_cd,need_mm_qty,need_psn_cnt,updated_at) ORDER BY psn_plan_id)::text FROM prj.psn_plan), (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(need_id,oppt_id,job_cd,grd_cd,psn_cnt,bgn_ym,mnth_qty,mth_mm_qty,use_yn,updated_at) ORDER BY need_id)::text FROM bsn.oppt_need), (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(oppt_id,oppt_stts_cd,cust_ptnr_id,win_prblt_rt,updated_at) ORDER BY oppt_id)::text FROM bsn.oppt)))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai.rcmd_rqst(rcmd_rqst_id,session_key_hash,rqst_ty_cd,prj_id,need_id,cond,scr_wght,rqst_at) VALUES(#{id},#{owner},#{type},#{projectId},#{needId},cast(#{document} AS jsonb),cast(#{weights} AS jsonb),#{at})
mapper.select: SELECT rcmd_rqst_id AS id,session_key_hash AS owner,cond::text AS document,rqst_at AS created_at FROM ai.rcmd_rqst WHERE rcmd_rqst_id=#{id}

choose.when: SELECT rcmd_next_rslt_id AS id,rqst_id AS request_id,dev_id,decision_cd AS decision,reject_rsn_desc AS reason,asgn_id,tmpr_asgn_id FROM ai.rcmd_next_rslt
choose.otherwise: SELECT rcmd_rslt_id AS id,rcmd_rqst_id AS request_id,dev_id,CASE WHEN rcmd_dcsn_cd='NONE' THEN 'PENDING' ELSE rcmd_dcsn_cd END AS decision,rjct_rsn_desc AS reason,asgn_id,tmpr_asgn_id FROM ai.rcmd_rslt

choose.when: UPDATE ai.rcmd_next_rslt SET decision_cd=#{decision},reject_rsn_desc=#{reason},dcsn_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE rcmd_next_rslt_id=#{id} AND decision_cd='PENDING'
choose.otherwise: UPDATE ai.rcmd_rslt SET rcmd_dcsn_cd=#{decision},rjct_rsn_desc=#{reason},dcsn_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE rcmd_rslt_id=#{id} AND rcmd_dcsn_cd='NONE'
